description: This file defines the LayerNode class, which extends PcbNode, representing a layer in a PCB design with properties such as the layer name and a method to identify silk screening layers.

classes.name: LayerNode
classes.description: Represents a PCB layer node with a name and a method to check if it is a silk screen layer.

methods.name: LayerNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LayerNode with a name, closing index, and list of child objects.

methods.name: isSikscreenLayer
methods.description: Checks if the layer is a silk screen layer based on its name.
